coordination.reason: No shared immutable macrocycle/request identifier was exposed and the available user-turn timestamp is minute precision only, so the canonical atomic fallback key cannot be reproduced safely.

material_finding.statement: The architecture requires JSPACE_VECTOR_CONTROL_ABI/v1 as a complete causal control packet, while current historical Trigger-1 source uses that literal inside a partial derivation/source hash preimage and retained PR1263 uses it for a q8 wire codec. Schema-name equality therefore does not imply semantic or wire compatibility.
material_finding.risk: Without one fail-closed semantic role, packet hashes, replay identity, provenance, trace linkage and future training rows can become ambiguous even when each producer is internally deterministic.

hypothesis: Reserving JSPACE_VECTOR_CONTROL_ABI/v1 for a complete evidence-bearing causal control packet and explicitly quarantining partial-descriptor/q8-codec uses will improve cross-mode provenance and make future Trigger-1 traces trainable without inventing missing causal facts.
counterhypothesis: The three uses are complementary views and can safely share one schema literal.
counterhypothesis_adjudication: REJECTED_AT_SOURCE_CONTRACT_SCOPE: their required preimages and semantics differ materially. Compatibility requires an explicit adapter or distinct namespace; it cannot be inferred from the shared literal.
